plausible_today: Under ker v=0 and absence of preceding-degree stable torsion the equivalence holds. In general the inequality defect is b+c whereas dim kerφ=c−dim ker v.
state_of_art: The exact elementary derivation in proofs.md §2 uses the opened base-change and stable-augmentation results. It shows a missing-hypothesis issue without claiming a geometric counterexample.

worth: High priority for the next scan-based commentary: first check whether a missing qualification removes the extra term.

title: FullGL_r(Fp) monodromy for fixed-X hypersurface sections
as_he_states: Is the varying stable coherent vanishing representation irreducible, or even full GL_r(Fp), for generic hypersurface sections of a fixed smooth projective X?
plausible_today: Specify geometric versus arithmetic image, degree range, rank, and fixed constant subquotients. Established full-image theorems for other parameter spaces do not imply this one.
state_of_art: Achter–Pries, Proposition 4.8 proves full mod p and p-adic monodromy on components of curve p-rank strata. Stienstra–van der Put–van der Marel studies specified unit-root families. Neither gives the exact arbitrary X theorem; searches recorded no matching general result.
why_open: No source located documents why this exact question remained open or was dropped.
worth: Highest research interest, but one short run should test a concreteX and degree and audit arithmetic determinants before attempting the universal claim.

title: Growth of generic stable vanishing rank
occurrences: cote 4:9,1179,deleted growth replaced by positivity;12,1307–1312; SA15-361,SA15-366; CL-SA15-367,CL-SA15-376
as_he_states: The early growth expression is weakened to positivity, but unbounded rank is needed again for the final monodromy/congruence programme.
plausible_today: For a fixed smooth projective n-fold X of degree D, the generic stable vanishing rank has leading term Dd^n/n!, hence tends to infinity.
state_of_art: Koblitz I, §5, Theorem 1 explicitly states the leading term for a constructed section; Lemma 4 transfers the stable-rank lower bound to a generic open for Cohen–Macaulay X in sufficiently high degree, and Theorem 2 combines them. The unread displayed defect inequality is not needed for this conclusion.
why_open: No source located documents why this exact question remained open or was dropped.
worth: The unboundedness branch is settled; the remaining research obstacle is the separate monodromy question.

title: Every-open hypersurface point-count residues
as_he_states: Use fullGL monodromy and every residue as a matrix trace to force specified point-count congruences in every nonempty parameter open after suitable finite field extension.
plausible_today: The conclusion is conditional on geometric monodromy and allowed Frobenius cosets, with fixed cohomological contributions controlled after extending constants. Variable extension degrees are part of the statement.
state_of_art: The trace-surjectivity calculation is proved independently. Katz, XXII, Corollary 3.2 gives the mod p cohomological trace congruence. The missing all X monodromy prevents an unconditional conclusion.
why_open: No source located documents why this exact question remained open or was dropped.
worth: Worth a concrete-family experiment only after its monodromy is established; the elementary trace input is already complete.
